news.title: Global Market: Japanese banks see rising corporate loan demand ahead of BOJ meeting
news.description: Japanese banks report rising corporate funding demand despite the Bank of Japan’s 1.25% interest rate, reinforcing expectations of further monetary tightening. Persistent inflation risks, resilient lending and government concerns will shape the central bank’s upcoming policy decision.

news.title: UBS acquires 4.8% stake in wealth manager 360 ONE WAM through warrant exercise
news.description: UBS has acquired a 4.8% stake in 360 ONE WAM by exercising 2.05 crore warrants and paying around Rs 1,584 crore. The transaction follows a partnership announced in April 2025, under which UBS agreed to sell its Indian onshore wealth management business to the Mumbai-based firm for about $32 million.
